name: coralogix-mcp
description: Connects Cursor to the Coralogix Observability MCP Server, letting your AI agent query logs, metrics, traces, and RUM, manage alerts and dashboards — all without leaving the editor.

CORALOGIX_DOMAIN.title: Coralogix Domain
CORALOGIX_DOMAIN.description: Select the Coralogix domain for your tenant based on the [Coralogix domain guide](https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/account-management/account-settings/coralogix-domain/)

CORALOGIX_MCP_TOOLSETS.title: Coralogix MCP Toolsets
CORALOGIX_MCP_TOOLSETS.description: Optional comma-separated toolsets to enable. Leave empty to load all tools. See the [Coralogix MCP tool catalog](https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/mcp-server/tools/catalog/) for available toolsets.
